QUOTE: "An application that defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` before including mbedtls headers gets direct access" and "by default the field is really called `private_name`. Code that writes `ssl->state` then fails to compile"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives both branches of the macro and says that consumers who define the opt-out see plain names, while ordinary consumers of the public headers see the `private_` names.
